Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: CREATION: PARTS OF CREATION
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: PP2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Creation: Parts of CREATION helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: CREATION: PARTS OF CREATION
Study Creation: Parts of CREATION like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Demonstrate some themselves as wonderfully 5.

What this means
In this part you learn to Demonstrate some themselves as wonderfully 5.. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Demonstrate some themselves as wonderfully 5..
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Creation: Parts of CREATION” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Demonstrate some themselves as wonderfully 5.. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate his/her parts colour pictures of parts of of the body as the body wonderfully made by •

What this means
In this part you learn to Appreciate his/her parts colour pictures of parts of of the body as the body wonderfully made by •. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Appreciate his/her parts colour pictures of parts of of the body as the body wonderfully made by •.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Appreciate his/her parts colour pictures of parts of of the body as the body wonderfully made by •. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Creation: Parts of CREATION is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Creation: Parts of CREATION” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: Demonstrate some themselves as wonderfully 5.)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Creation: Parts of CREATION in your own words. (skill: Appreciate his/her parts colour pictures of parts of of the body as the body wonderfully made by •)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Creation: Parts of CREATION to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Demonstrate some themselves as wonderfully 5..
3. Practise this skill: Appreciate his/her parts colour pictures of parts of of the body as the body wonderfully made by •.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Creation: Parts of CREATION from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Creation: Parts of CREATION: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP2 learner study Creation: Parts of CREATION?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How many eyes do you to: different parts of the body have?
2. How many hands do you the body that God Corinthians 6:19) have?
3. How many ears do you image and likeness songs appreciating have?
4. How many legs do you ways of caring parts of made by God (Psalms 139- have?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Creation: Parts of CREATION means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: Demonstrate some themselves as wonderfully 5..
5. Be able to: Appreciate his/her parts colour pictures of parts of of the body as the body wonderfully made by •.
